Personality: Germilqart, a prominent figure of the Magonids, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Germilqart owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Magonids. Historical Record: Head of the Magonid house, heirs of the old kings who built Carthage's first empire. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
